1955MattelMousegetarWithJimmieDodd: Head Mouseketeer Jimmie Dodd promotes the Mousegetar (as seen on the show) and a cheaper jack-in-the-box style crank-toy, the Mousegetar Jr., in this 1955 commercial. Can't say for certain, but this probably debuted during episode #30 of "the Mickey Mouse Club" (November 11, 1955) after Dodd was presented with his Mousegetar by the Mouseketeers. The Mousegetar retailed for $4 and the Mousegetar Jr. for $1.80, but today they sell in the triple-digits.
Soundac_Commercials: This is a compilation of animated commercials made by Soundac in the 50s and 60s. They produced several more, but most of them have been lost to time since their closure in the early 1970s. I'm aware that the screen moves weirdly in some of these ads, but this was how I found them and I have no idea why someone would do this.
